conflict_signals: The WebUI Browser impl or browser_tests source set is renamed or split.
WebUIBrowserUI stops owning the chrome://webui-browser data source.
SetupWebUIDataSource no longer installs the upstream WebUI Browser resources.
SetRequestFilter changes its request matching or callback lifetime contract.
The external build_webui target or generated include config no longer resolves through a system-absolute GN label.
patches.removal_condition: Remove this patch when Chromium provides a supported external WebUI Browser frontend resource provider and browser-test dependency seam, or remove it if the Gate 2 substrate experiment fails.

conflict_signals: BrowserView child construction or accessible-pane ordering changes.
BrowserViewLayoutViews or BrowserViewTabbedLayoutImpl is renamed or split.
The normal-window type contract changes.
The external product label no longer resolves through a system-absolute GN label.
Chromium adds a supported macOS native-shell composition seam.
patches.removal_condition: Remove this experimental patch if the interactive Gate 2B accessibility and visual gate fails for a product defect, when another shell boundary is selected, or when Chromium exposes a supported macOS native-shell composition seam.

conflict_signals: NodeId or TabHandle resolution no longer proves tab liveness through the UI-process-wide handle factory.
WebUIBrowserPageHandler no longer resolves its owning Browser through WebUIBrowserUI.
TabStripModel membership semantics or GetIndexOfTab changes.
Chromium adds equivalent requesting-Browser authorization before creating a guest handler.
patches.removal_condition: Remove this patch when Chromium enforces equivalent requesting-Browser scope for WebUI Browser tab handles, or remove it if the WebUI Browser candidate is no longer used.

conflict_signals: WebUIBrowserGuestHandler stops being a document-scoped command endpoint for one tab's contents.
TabInterface detach or contents-discard callback contracts change.
BrowserWindowInterface close notification semantics change.
WebUIBrowserWindow page-info anchoring or security-state ownership changes.
Chromium adds equivalent revocable, browser-scoped GuestHandler command capabilities.
patches.removal_condition: Remove this patch when Chromium provides equivalent browser-, profile-, tab-, contents-, and lifecycle-scoped GuestHandler command authorization, or remove it if the WebUI Browser candidate is no longer used.

conflict_signals: BrowserView no longer constructs the optional product-owned rail after the authoritative tab list exists.
Horizontal or vertical Chromium tab-strip construction, initialization, mode switching, accessibility, or teardown moves outside the patched BrowserView symbols.
BrowserWindowInterface or TabListInterface lifetime and construction ordering changes.
The product-owned rail requires a WebContents native view or duplicate tab state.
Chromium adds a supported native product-sidebar construction seam.
patches.removal_condition: Remove this patch when Chromium exposes a supported native product-sidebar construction seam, when another shell boundary is selected, or if the interactive Gate 2B gate fails for a product defect.

conflict_signals: BrowserView renderer keyboard prehandling moves relative to editable-content checks or Chromium accelerator resolution.
BrowserNativeWidgetMac no longer installs its per-window command dispatcher in OnWindowInitialized.
CommandDispatcherDelegate, ChromeCommandDispatcherDelegate, native event redispatch, or first-responder precedence changes.
The exact normal-window SwiftUI rail and its controller are no longer available when the native window is initialized.
Chromium adds a supported per-window command or accelerator seam that spans renderer and native Views routes with stock fallback.
patches.removal_condition: Remove this patch when Chromium exposes a supported per-window command or accelerator seam spanning renderer and native Views routes with unchanged stock fallback, when another shell boundary is selected, or if the interactive Gate 2B input gate fails for a product defect.

conflict_signals: Session command rebuild ownership moves out of BuildCommandsForBrowser or BuildCommandsForTab.
Parsed session window or tab extra data moves away from ProcessSessionWindows or RestoreTab.
Normal-window session restoration no longer creates authoritative browsers and tabs at the patched restore points.
The public session-restored callback no longer runs after restored tabs, native split reconstruction, and selected-tab restoration are authoritative.
The external product workspace target no longer resolves through the shared limitless_root argument.
Chromium adds a supported external provider for rebuilding and restoring typed window and tab session metadata.
patches.removal_condition: Remove this patch when Chromium exposes a supported external session metadata provider that covers both rebuild and restore, or remove it with the native workspace feature if that product journey is removed.

conflict_signals: Session split visual data stops being restored by CreateTabsAndWindows.
SplitTabVisualData changes its finite inclusive ratio contract or layout fallback semantics.
The components sessions unit-test target stops linking session_command_unittest.cc.
Chromium begins strictly validating split visual data before the session parser receives it.
patches.removal_condition: Remove this patch when Chromium validates restored split ratios as finite values in the inclusive range from zero to one while preserving prior valid state and subsequent command processing.

tests: //chrome/test:interactive_ui_tests --gtest_filter=DetachToBrowserTabDragControllerTest.*EditabilityNotifiesBothWindowsAfterRealDropCompletes* on supported platforms; macOS arm64 remains an explicit native system-DnD external gate
conflict_signals: TabDragController no longer owns the successful desktop Views drag-start transition.
TabStrip drag-end animation no longer clears per-tab dragging state through ResetDraggingStateDelegate before OnBoundsAnimatorDone.
BrowserTabStripController::OnStoppedDragging or profile-wide TabListInterface editability semantics change.
Chromium adds a generic observer signal after every affected tab list becomes editable following a desktop Views drag.
patches.removal_condition: Remove this patch when Chromium exposes a generic profile-wide tab-list editability observer whose terminal editable notification is guaranteed after drag-controller teardown and dragged-tab animation cleanup.

tests: //chrome/test:interactive_ui_tests --gtest_filter=LimitlessSplitPaneDragInteractiveUiTest.RealViewsWholeSplitDropPreservesAuthoritativePair on supported platforms; macOS arm64 remains an explicit native system-DnD external gate
